title: 第23章 受委屈第24章 她不让
slug: 夫人她只想修仙第370章自爆
content_zh:
颜筝不知道之前发生的事，只以为一闭眼一睁眼的功夫。
现下听沈云熠的话，尚且没转过来弯，便见沈云熠仿佛再也撑不准一般，轰然倒地。
“沈云熠！”
颜筝惊得当一下弹了起来，紧张的打量他的眉眼，见他呼吸绵长依旧，方才松了口气，艰难地把他搬上床。
眨眼前间，两人位置对调！
“呀！
小师姐！”
颜筝下意识回头。
过分灿烂的阳光照屋内，颜筝大病初愈的脸庞竟添了几分清冷气。
她不笑的时候和颜桐有五六分相似。
少女呆愣在原地：“小师姐，你的病好了？”
颜筝一下想起来了。
她修炼时了岔子，倒也不是什么小事，引得内外门弟子都是惊奇。
她濒临晕迷前见到的人并非来帮忙的，是吃瓜群众，但之后，她的确倒了，他们又的确是来帮忙的。
来的很多。
他们放下凡人的偏见，只有救回他们的小师姐这一个想法。
为此，可以暂时搁置自己的功课。
归根到底。
他们都因为时间的飞快流逝，变得无比柔软。
“小师姐，您醒了，真是太好啦！”

少女一面迈进林端布下的结界，一面道，“大家都担心你的时间因此白白流逝呢！”
“有什么好的流逝，外界一年，内里五年，我干躺着也能熬好几个十年啊！”
颜筝没好气地说，“你们的时间是被延长了，而非缩短！”
“可是，最近的天，”
少女欲言又止，抬头看了看天，转眼间，又黑了。
“别看了！
你们小师兄晕过去了！
大师兄呢？”
颜筝又急又气，无力又无奈。
沈云熠人缘到底差到什么程度，那么大一个人倒在床上，陈盈居然也只当没看见？
不对，她好像是真的没看见。
少女一扭头，看见英俊潇洒的小师兄如此狼狈，当真吓了一跳，差点跌出木屋：“小师兄！
小师兄怎么受了这么重……”
她的话一顿。
少女也是医修，望，闻，问，切，看就能干两样。
content_en:
Yan Zheng didn't know what happened before, he only thought it was a matter of closing and opening his eyes.
Now after listening to Shen Yunyi's words, before turning around, Shen Yunyi suddenly fell to the ground as if he could no longer hold on.
"Shen Yunyi!"
Yan Zheng jumped up in shock, and looked at his features nervously. Seeing that his breathing was still long, she breathed a sigh of relief and moved him onto the bed with difficulty.
In the blink of an eye, their positions were reversed!
"Yeah!
Little senior sister! "
Yan Zheng turned around subconsciously.
The excessively bright sunshine shone into the room, and Yan Zheng's face, which had just recovered from a serious illness, was actually a little cooler.
When she's not smiling, she looks a lot like Yan Tong.
The girl was stunned on the spot: "Senior sister, have you recovered from your illness?"
Yan Zheng suddenly remembered.
Something went wrong while she was practicing, but it was not a trivial matter, which aroused surprise among the inner and outer disciples.
The people she saw before she was on the verge of fainting were not here to help, they were people eating melons. But after that, she did collapse, and they were indeed here to help.
There are many coming.
They put aside their mortal prejudices and only had the idea of ​​saving their little senior sister.
For this reason, you can put your homework on hold for a while.
Ultimately.
They all became extremely soft due to the rapid passage of time.
"Sister, it's great that you're awake!"
As the girl stepped into the barrier set up by Lin Duan, she said, "Everyone is worried that your time will be wasted because of this!"
"What good time passes? One year on the outside and five years on the inside. I can survive several decades even if I just lie down!"
Yan Zheng said angrily, "Your time has been extended, not shortened!"
"But, these days,"
The girl stopped talking and looked up at the sky. In a blink of an eye, it was dark again.
"Stop looking!
Your little senior brother fainted!
Where's the senior brother? "
Yan Zheng was anxious and angry, powerless and helpless.
How bad is Shen Yunyi's popularity? Chen Ying just pretended not to see such an old man lying on the bed?
No, it seemed like she really didn't see it.
The girl turned her head and saw the handsome little senior brother in such a mess. She was really frightened and almost fell out of the cabin: "Little senior brother!
Why did the little senior brother suffer so badly..."
She stopped talking.
The girl is also a medical practitioner. She can do two things: looking, smelling, asking, cutting, and seeing.
